sentences.en: Firing no shot in his defence, his little troop swelled until it became an army.
sentences.vi: Không bắn được phát súng nào trong phòng thủ của anh ta, đội quân nhỏ của anh ta đã tăng lên cho đến khi nó trở thành một đội quân.

sentences.en: The leader of a third troop took a humbler tone, sued for mercy, and obtained it.

sentences.en: The local troop should wear the same style of uniform.

sentences.en: At this time, the troop awards the badge to the young man.

sentences.en: As a young man he saw service in the Netherlands under the command of his brother, and in the "Bishops' War" he commanded a troop of horse in King Charles I.'s army.

sentences.en: The wife of John Casimir, a Frenchwoman, Marie Louise, hired a troop of French actors and first familiarized the Poles with something which resembled the modern stage.

sentences.en: The troop commander can then counter specific hostile intelligence efforts.
